name: sidc_function_map
title: Military symbol function rules (data/sidc_function_map.csv)
description: Hand-maintained reference table (roadmap 410; Scott accepted the proposal on 23 November 2026). One row per rule that turns a unit of data/units.csv into the date-independent digits of its MIL-STD-2525D / APP-6D SIDC (symbol set, HQ/TF/dummy, entity, modifiers, echelon override). scripts/sidc.py applies the first `function` row (in file order) whose conditions all hold, then the `addon` rows to land units. The last function row is GZ99 with no condition. See docs/symbol_codes_proposal.md.

fields.name: rule_id
fields.description: Unique rule id (for example GI01, SH-DD).

fields.name: kind
fields.description: `function` (gives the symbol) or `addon` (land units only: modifier 2 Airborne when still blank, or the Task Force digit).

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Condition: ground, air or naval (a blank domain in data/units.csv counts as ground); blank = any.

fields.name: echelon
fields.description: Condition: an echelon value (vocabulary echelon); blank = any.

fields.name: ship_type
fields.description: Condition: the unit's ship_type; blank = any.

fields.name: name_pattern
fields.description: Condition: a Python regular expression searched case-insensitively in unit_name; blank = any.

fields.name: symbol_set
fields.description: Digits 5-6: 10 Land Unit, 30 Sea Surface, 35 Sea Subsurface (blank on addon rows).

fields.name: entity
fields.description: Digits 11-16: the entity/type/subtype code of data/sidc_codes.csv in that symbol set.

fields.name: modifier1
fields.description: Digits 17-18 (blank = 00); a modifier1 code of data/sidc_codes.csv.

fields.name: modifier2
fields.description: Digits 19-20 (blank = 00); a modifier2 code of data/sidc_codes.csv.

fields.name: hq_tf_dummy
fields.description: Digit 8: 0 none, 2 headquarters, 4 task force (addon: 4, or 6 when the rule already gave 2).

fields.name: amplifier_override
fields.description: Digits 9-10 instead of the echelon map (two digits), for example 26 for OKW; blank = from data/sidc_echelon_map.csv.

fields.name: entity_label
fields.description: The 2525D label of the entity (or what the addon adds).

fields.name: case
fields.description: exact, nearest, no-exact, default, default-infantry or addon (docs/symbol_codes_coverage.md).

fields.name: note
fields.description: Why the rule maps as it does; changes are annotated here and in docs/changelog.md.
